title: Tow Away No Stopping Peak Period Sign with 2 Hour Parking Panel (Sheet 3 of 4)
summary: Fabrication layout for an 18 in. x 36 in. LADOT Anti-Gridlock Zone tow-away sign with a single peak period (4 to 6 PM) No Stopping legend over a green 2 Hour Parking 8 AM to 4 PM panel. All lettering sizes and series, vertical spacings and the 1-1/2 in. corner radius are dimensioned. Notes cover manufacturer, border, required bottom markings and .080 aluminum with SEG Type II graffiti film.
description:
Front elevation of the sign, drawn at 18" wide by 36" high with a 1-1/2" radius at the outer corners. The sign is three stacked panels separated by 1/4" gaps: a red header panel, a white-field red-bordered No Stopping panel, and a green-bordered parking panel.

Header panel (red, 6" high): white legend ANTI-GRIDLOCK on the first line and ZONE on the second, both 2" Series C, with L.A.M.C. 80.70 below in 1/2" Series C.

No Stopping panel (17-1/2" high): across the top is a red band with a white tow-truck-towing-car pictograph, 3-3/4" high. Below it a red block with the white word NO beside the word STOPPING in red on white, 3" Series B (the NO block is shown as 8" from the top of the panel, with a 3-1/2" Series B dimension and 1/2" below the text). Next is 4 TO 6 PM in red, with the 4 and 6 in 3" Series C, PM in 2" Series C and the underlined TO in 1" Series C. Below are EXCEPT SATURDAY & SUNDAY and TO RECOVER IMPOUNDED VEHICLE CALL 3-1-1, each in 1/2" Series C. Vertical dimensions at the left of this panel include 1-3/4", 1", 1-3/4" and 1-1/2" spacings between lines.

Parking panel (green, 12" high): a green block at upper left with a white 2 in 3-1/2" Series D, 6" high, beside HOUR over PARKING in green; HOUR is 2" Series E and PARKING is 2-1/2" Series C. Below, 8 AM TO 4 PM is green with 8 and 4 in 2-1/2" Series C, AM and PM in 1-3/4" Series C and the underlined TO in 1" Series C, then EXCEPT SUNDAY in 1/2" Series C. A 1" dimension is shown below the 6" block and 1-3/4" at the bottom margin.

Overall height dimension 36" at far left, with the panel heights 6", 17-1/2" and 12" and the three 1/4" gaps shown inside it.

Title block: City of Los Angeles Department of Transportation, Tow Away No Stopping Peak Period Sign, sheet 3 of 4, drawing S-515.0, approved July 21, 2010 for Rita L. Robinson, General Manager.
notes:
Notes:
1. Sign shall be fabricated by a qualified, professional sign manufacturer approved by LADOT.
2. Sign size is 18" x 36", and legend lettering size shall be as noted above. The font is as noted. All lines of legend are to be centered. The border shall be 1/4" wide and spaced 1/4" from edge of sign.
3. All signs shall include (reading left to right) at the bottom of the sign the following information: a) if fabricated by a private contractor, a manufacture "code" and date of fabrication e.g. "SM 09 / 05", b) "Property of City of Los Angeles", c) LADOT Stock Number (four numbers).
4. Sign shall be made of .080 aluminum and have reflective SEG Type II material with graffiti film.

title: Typical Pavement Marking Installations
summary: Typical layouts for word and symbol pavement markings and for limit and yield lines. Shows WAIT HERE legends, STOP (R1-1) and YIELD (R1-2) limit line placement, a BUS ZONE with bike symbol, STOP AHEAD, PED XING and SLOW SCHOOL XING legends spaced 32 ft, and a left-turn arrow pair. A table gives the C distance by posted speed, 100 ft at 25 mph to 325 ft at 50 mph.
description:
Sheet is not to scale. It holds seven small plan views and one table.

Wait here legend (upper left): plan of an intersection approach with a curb return at each side, a stop bar across the lanes, a solid double centerline and dashed lane lines. Two lanes carry the legends HERE above WAIT, set 8' apart, with 8' dimensions shown between the stop bar, the first legend and the second.

STOP limit line, R1-1 (upper middle): plan of a corner with an access ramp and the property line. The STOP legend is placed back from the limit line with an 8' dimension and a 5' minimum dimension between the curb line extended and the limit line. A R1-1 STOP sign is shown beside it.

YIELD line, R1-2 (upper right): a row of four yield triangles (shark teeth), 36" high, with 12" wide triangles spaced 24" apart (12" and 24" dimensions shown). A R1-2 YIELD sign is shown beside it.

Text under these views reads as the first note below.

Bus zone (middle left): a curb-side bus zone with a dashed lane line, the legend BUS ZONE along the curb, a bike symbol and arrow inside a bike lane with a 6' dimension, and a curb return at the bottom.

Stop ahead (middle): a lane with a stop bar, a crosswalk edge at the top, the legend AHEAD above STOP in the lane, a dimension C from the stop bar to the first legend and 32' between the legends.

Ped crossing (middle): a marked crosswalk of seven bars at the top, solid and dashed lane lines, the legend XNG above PED with dimension C from the crosswalk and 32' between legends.

School crossing (middle right): a marked crosswalk at the top, the legends XNG, SCHOOL and SLOW stacked in the lane, with dimension C from the crosswalk and 32' between each legend.

Turn arrows (lower left): plan of a left-turn lane of length L measured from the limit line. A left-turn arrow is placed at the limit line end of the lane and another L/2 back, with the callout Install if L >= 250'. A tapered lane line is shown at the lane start.

Table: Posted speed (mph) 25, 30, 35, 40, 45, 50 with C* (ft) 100, 100, 125, 175, 250, 325 respectively.

Title block: City of Los Angeles Department of Transportation, Typical Pavement Marking Installations, sheet 1 of 1, drawing S-517.0, approved December 11, 2008 for Rita L. Robinson, General Manager. Drawn M.T. 11-20-08.
notes:
1. Generally, limit and yield lines are located along the extension of the property line. They shall be placed at the near side or upstream of the flat portion (w) of any access ramp. The distance between the curb line extended and the limit line shall be at least 5 feet. The limit line should extend to the middle of the street or the striped centerline.
2. * Distance may exceed the dimensions in the table by up to 100' in order to adjust to the field conditions.
3. Callout: Install if L >= 250'. Not to scale.

title: Typical Street Closure for Farmers' Market
summary: Typical traffic control plan for closing one block of street for a Sunday Farmers' Market, 8 AM to 2 PM. Type III barricades with R11-2 Road Closed signs close the block at both ends, R3-1 and R3-2 turn prohibition signs and 8 AM to 2 PM Sunday No Parking signs are posted at the corners, and Modified W20-3 Road Closed Ahead signs are placed about 245 ft upstream. Six notes cover the fire lane, barricade gaps, cones, sign costs, permittee duties and additional controls.
description:
Plan view (not to scale): a one-block street closure shown as a hatched area labeled Farmers' Market between two side streets at the left and right and an alley with an R11-2 barricade on each side of the market block. The cross streets above and below the closure each show dashed lane lines and a double centerline. At each of the four corners of the closed block a Type III barricade is shown at the curb return with R3-1* (no right turn) and R3-2* (no left turn) sign callouts, and three Type III barricades with R11-2 callouts span the street at the top and bottom edges of the market block. R11-2 is also called out at each alley entrance.

At each corner, on the sides of the market block, a red and white No Parking sign (circled P) reading 8 AM to 2 PM, SUNDAY, FARMERS' MARKET with an arrow is mounted on a post, with arrows pointing to the sign locations (sign on post). Modified W20-3* advance signs are located on each approach about 245 ft (245' +/-) upstream of the intersection, drawn at the top and bottom of the plan. A line of red dots with the callout See note 3 marks traffic cones along the approach turn lane tapers at the top and right.

Legend (right): Sign on post symbol, Type III barricade symbol, the MOD. W20-3 yellow diamond sign reading ROAD CLOSED AHEAD with a yellow plate below reading 8 AM to 2 PM SUNDAY, the R11-2 ROAD CLOSED sign, R3-1 (no right turn) and R3-2 (no left turn) signs, an 8 AM to 2 PM SUNDAY restriction plate, and a traffic cone 28" tall with two retroreflective bands.

Title block: City of Los Angeles Department of Transportation, Typical Street Closure for Farmers' Market, sheet 1 of 1, drawing S-518.0, approved November 17, 2009 for Rita L. Robinson, General Manager. Drawn MT 11-12-09.
notes:
* Add restriction plate (hours of parking, turn restrictions and road closure to be shown on permit)
Notes:
1. Maintain 20' fire lane through closure area.
2. Type III barricades shall cover entire street with no more than a 4' gap between barricades or barricade and curb.
3. Minimum 28" tall traffic cone spaced a maximum 25' apart on all turn lanes into closure area.
4. Permanent signs to be installed by LADOT. Permittee shall reimburse LADOT for the sign fabrication and installation cost.
5. Permittee shall provide, install and maintain barricades, R11-2 signs mounted on barricades and traffic cones as shown. Permittee must wear safety vest, conforming to ANSI/ISEA 107-2004 when installing and removing signs, cones, and barricades.
6. Additional traffic controls may be required as determined by LADOT.

title: Typical Street Closure for Neighborhood Block Party
summary: Typical plan for closing one residential block between two cross streets for a neighborhood block party. Type II barricades with R11-2 Road Closed signs close both ends of the block, and optional Temporary No Parking signs (8 AM to 5 PM Sunday) are posted on posts at the four corners. Five notes cover the fire lane, barricade gaps, who supplies signs and barricades, optional sign cost reimbursement and additional controls.
description:
Plan view (not to scale): a vertical block of street shown with a hatched area labeled Block Party between a cross street at the top and one at the bottom, each with curb returns and a double centerline. Across the street at the top end of the block three Type II barricades are drawn with R11-2 callouts, and the same three barricades with R11-2 callouts are drawn at the bottom end.

At each of the four block corners a sign on a post is called out with a leader line to an enlarged red and white Temporary No Parking sign reading TEMPORARY, NO PARKING, 8 AM to 5 PM, SUNDAY. Two enlarged signs are placed to the left of the block and two to the right (the lower right and upper left leaders point to the corner posts).

Legend (right): Type II barricade symbol, and the R11-2 ROAD CLOSED sign (white with black border and legend).

Title block: City of Los Angeles Department of Transportation, Typical Street Closure for Neighborhood Block Party, sheet 1 of 1, drawing S-519.0, approved December 10, 2009 for Rita L. Robinson, General Manager. Drawn MT 12-10-09.
notes:
Notes:
1. Maintain 20' fire lane through closure area.
2. Type II barricades shall cover entire street with no more than a 4' gap between barricades or barricade and curb.
3. Permittee shall obtain R11-2 signs and barricades from the Bureau of Street Services and install and maintain barricades as shown. Permittee must wear safety vest, conforming to ANSI/ISEA 107-2004 when installing and removing signs and barricades.
4. The installation of Temporary No Parking signs are optional. If requested by permittee, LADOT shall be reimbursed for the installation cost.
5. Additional traffic controls may be required as determined by LADOT.

title: Council District Field Office Sign
summary: Fabrication layout for a 36 in. x 60 in. blue reflectorized Council District Field Office sign with a 12 in. City Seal, the Councilmember's name, title and district, and the words FIELD OFFICE. Text gives size, material, installation on two heavy duty posts at 10 ft clearance, and who is responsible for name, fabrication and installation.
description:
Elevation of the sign: 60" wide by 36" high with 2" radius corners and a 1/4" border set 1/2" from the edge. The legend is centered and stacked: a 12" City Seal (City of Los Angeles seal) centered on the top edge of the sign overlapping the border, then the example name John Ferraro in 6" Series C, then Councilmember, 4th District in 3" Series C (with 2" Series C for the superscript th), then FIELD OFFICE in 4" Series C.

Vertical spacing, top to bottom along the right side, within the 36" height: 10" space, 6" Series C, 4" space, 3" Series C and 2" Series C, 4" space, 4" Series C, 5" space. The 60" width is dimensioned below the sign.

Text sections below the drawing are titled Sign, Installation and Authority.

Title block: City of Los Angeles Department of Transportation, Council District Field Office Sign, sheet 1 of 1, drawing S-520.0, approved February 9, 2010 for Rita L. Robinson, General Manager. Drawn MT 2-3-10.
notes:
Sign: Size shall be 36" vertically and 60" horizontally. Background color shall be blue and reflectorized. Letters and border are white. Anti graffiti film shall be used. Material shall be 0.08 inch minimum thickness aluminum stock. Corners of sign shall be 2 inch radius.
Installation: Signs shall be installed on two heavy duty sign posts. Signs may not be installed on traffic signal poles, or on street lighting poles. Signs should be installed at a clearance height of 10 feet so they will be less prone to vandalism.
Authority: District Office is responsible for determining the exact name and spelling on the sign. Fabrication and installation work orders should be initiated by District Office. Field Operations should install the signs on or before the effective date the new Councilmember assumes office.
Callouts: 1/4" border 1/2" from edge. 12" City Seal. 2" radius.
